import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const STUB =
  `#!/bin/sh
systemctl is-system-running --quiet || exit 77
`;
test('acceptance: the stub is a script', () => {
  assert.ok(STUB.startsWith('#!') && typeof spawnSync === 'function');
});
